option_relations.rationale: Uveitic cystoid macular edema is a direct match for the leaf label 'Uveitic Cystoid Macular Edema'
Anastrozole-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema matches the leaf labels 'Anastrozole-induced Uveitis' and 'Anastrozole-associated Uveitis with Cystoid Macular Edema'
Drug-induced uveitis (anastrozole) is a subtype of the leaf label 'Anastrozole-induced Uveitis'
Idiopathic uveitis with cystoid macular edema matches the leaf labels 'Idiopathic Uveitis' and 'Idiopathic Uveitis with Cystoid Macular Edema'
